title: Cross-project lessons
description: Cluster lessons across all projects and propose shared skills.

steps.name: cluster
steps.prompt: Use the control plane API at $API_URL (curl is fine; JSON responses). Useful routes: GET /projects, GET /projects/:id, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id/events, GET /graph/:id, GET /workflows, GET /workflows/:id, GET /brief?hours=N, GET /audit?limit=N, GET /chores, GET /ledgers?status=signed, GET /proposals, POST /workflows, POST /projects, POST /projects/:id/continue, POST /chores, POST /tasks/:id/go. GET /sessions and collect props.lessons across all projects for the last 14 days, plus GET /proposals. Cluster lessons that say the same thing in different words. For each cluster with 3+ members across 2+ projects, write a candidate SKILL.md section (name, when to use, the rule) into LESSONS.md, citing the session ids as evidence.

steps.name: review
steps.prompt: Review LESSONS.md: are the clusters real or coincidental, and are the proposed rules specific enough to act on? Report only.
